assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 2D game asset for a Chinese Liaozhai folktale turn-based RPG. Polished charming 16-bit pixel art, clearly visible square pixel clusters, limited coordinated palette of jade/teal, warm cream, muted indigo, coral and ochre, clean dark pixel outlines, hand-placed pixel shading. Friendly, whimsical and slightly eerie. NO logos, NO words or letters, NO interface. Not photorealistic, not watercolor, not vector. Do not depict any existing franchise characters. Asset type: wide landscape battle background, aspect ratio 16:9. A moonlit little Chinese Ming/Qing village courtyard seen from the side at a slightly elevated classic handheld RPG battle angle, with blue-grey curved tiled roofs, white plaster walls, wooden lattice windows glowing warm orange, a willow and bamboo at the edges, distant layered jade hills under a dusty periwinkle sky, a large pale warm moon and a few stars. A small old circular stone well sits at the upper right rear beside the wall. The foreground and midground are broad uncluttered sandy jade-green and light ochre courtyard ground so two separate character sprites can be overlaid at lower-left and upper-right. Leave these battle positions clear. Flat horizontal ground plane, no strong perspective grid. Keep the scene much lighter and more playful than realistic horror. Balanced bright dusk colors, cozy lanterns, gentle mystery. No people, no creatures, no masks, no UI, no typography.
